neighbours.label: One thing is enough: a single item or no effort suffices for the whole job ('with a single tap', 'you only need one', 'without doing anything')
fire: With a single tap, your whole playlist is ready to go.
You only need one password to open all your accounts.
Just one scoop of this powder makes a full gallon of juice.
All it takes is a single phone call to cancel the plan.
The printer sets itself up without you doing anything at all.
One simple switch turns off every light in the house.
This tool merges your files with just one command.
You can pay every bill from a single screen.
quiet: After many taps, your whole playlist is finally ready to go.
You need a different password to open each of your accounts.
Forty scoops of this powder make a full gallon of juice.
It takes a long series of phone calls to cancel the plan.
The printer needs you to set up every part by hand.
Each of the twelve switches turns off a light in the house.
This tool merges your files with dozens of separate commands.
A single father sat beside me and watched the screen.

notes: Probes: 'a single' as an enabling means 0.22-0.62, but 'each player has a single' and 'a single father' near zero. 'A few clicks' 0.22 against 'dozens of clicks' 0.02, so the meaning carries some of it beyond the word.
